department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; this deadline also covers funding consideration.
deadline.quote: Apply by December 1 for Fall 2027 admission.

gre_subject.quote: There are no required subject tests.

toefl_min.value: MatSE wants TOEFL iBT 103 (old scale) for full-status admission; lower scores meeting the university minimum get limited status only rarely.
toefl_min.quote: The Department requires a minimum TOEFL score of 103 and an IELTS score of 7.5 for full status admission.

ielts_min.quote: The Department requires a minimum TOEFL score of 103 and an IELTS score of 7.5 for full status admission.

supervisor.value: You apply to the department; all PhD students join a research group by the end of September of their first semester.
supervisor.quote: All PhD students join a research group early in their first semester (by the end of September).

funding.value: The Grainger Engineering five-year PhD funding guarantee covers tuition and a stipend for fall and spring.
funding.quote: Through the Grainger Engineering Five-Year Ph.D. Funding Guarantee, Ph.D. students in their first five years of enrollment are guaranteed a funded appointment for fall and spring that includes a full tuition waiver and stipend.

entry_route.value: Apply directly to the PhD with a bachelor's or with a master's.
entry_route.quote: If you intend to pursue the Ph.D. program with a bachelor's degree (or equivalent), without a master's degree, apply directly to the Ph.D. program (not to the M.S. program).

notes: The department offers no fee waivers.
